title: Milkshade Dynamics
description: Dynamic Lighting, Entity Lighting, True Darkness, Night Darkness. All client side, all toggleable.
body:
**Four toggleable, adjustable lighting features, all client-side.**

**Dynamic Lighting.** 

Torches, lanterns, or any light-emitting block in your hand casts moving light that fades in and out.

![dark](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea89d0cf47801c20a4c7dee36ffdf16a8236ff0f_0.webp)

**Entity Lighting.** 

Fireballs, guardian lasers, fireflies, explosions, and more, all glowing in real time as they fly and blast.

![blazes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d256d0cfff88cc480db6f9c1e5e3551b416f2a7_0.webp)

**True Darkness.** 

Four levels, from off to pitch black caves and dark nights.

![city](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a421a511aa250dd8d3870876565ef808fdf21e65_0.webp)

**Night Darkness.**

Four levels, from off to fully black nights. Smoothly dims the sky from dusk to midnight.

![Outside with night darkness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4cd87a9515551f584afedc3b7757e85708837a8_0.webp)

Press J to open settings. Rebindable in Controls.

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a22d458872a2547348b2d14632dd7c2d1c48592_0.webp)
